text: This report proposes a draft amendment to the City's Official Plan to provide greater clarity regarding when an Official Plan Amendment is required for certain disposals of City-owned land in Parks and Open Space Areas and the Green Space System to facilitate conservation projects, public transit and essential public works and utilities that support Toronto's development, growth and quality of life. Lands designated as Parks and Open Space Areas and lands comprising the Green Space System in the Official Plan accommodate natural habitat areas, important ecological services and many of the City's recreation opportunities. These lands are essential to health, prosperity and quality of life in our City and are afforded a high level of protection in the Official Plan.
